decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of efficient removal and disruption to control the game while overwhelming the opponent with fast and powerful creatures. The key concept is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and removal spells, and finish them off with a mix of evasive threats and powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional aggression and versatility, while cards like Mutavault and Bloodtithe Harvester help maintain a steady board presence.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards that benefit from having a high devotion to green mana symbols, enabling powerful effects and a strong board presence. By playing cards that add to green mana sources and utilizing cards with strong devotion effects like Leyline of the Guildpact and Invasion of Ixalan, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and large creatures. Supporting cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help to maintain card advantage and accelerate the deck's game plan. Ultimately, the deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victory through a strong green devotion strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Chord of Calling, and Collected Company to generate large amounts of life gain and create a win condition with Aetherflux Reservoir. The deck utilizes a mix of creatures with ETB effects to gain life and generate value, while also including cards like Sentinel of the Nameless City and Extraction Specialist for additional combo pieces. The mana base is designed to support the combo strategy and enable consistent casting of important spells.

The deck revolves around utilizing the diverse color palette of Niv-Mizzet Reborn to control the game state and outvalue the opponent. It aims to generate card advantage through Niv-Mizzet's ETB ability and cascade spells like Bring to Light. The deck also includes powerful removal options like Vanishing Verse and Lightning Helix to control the board. With strong mana fixing and a companion like Yorion, Sky Nomad, the deck aims to establish a solid board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, it seeks to grind out incremental advantages and overwhelm the opponent with its versatile card pool.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay to overwhelm opponents quickly. The deck includes efficient creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear, as well as burn spell support like Play with Fire and Wizard's Lightning. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional versatility to the deck. The deck also features lands that support the aggressive strategy, like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure and quickly close out games with a strong creature presence and burn spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption spells to control the board and pressure opponents. It utilizes cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper to quickly deal damage while using Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional creature support and sorcery speed threats, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can act as a finisher or card draw engine. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence, apply pressure, and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays with creatures like Dusk Legion Zealot, Vein Ripper, and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes powerful cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet to control the board and provide additional benefits to your creatures. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and hand disruption like Thoughtseize to disrupt your opponent's game plan. The mana base is constructed to support the aggressive playstyle, allowing you to curve out efficiently and apply pressure to your opponent.

This aggro deck focuses on quick and consistent damage output through efficient and low-cost burn spells, backed up by aggressive creatures with haste and prowess abilities. The deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent by constantly attacking with creatures and burning face when necessary, ultimately overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize or gain control of the game. The inclusion of versatile lands and spells that can deal direct damage allow for flexibility in dealing with opposing threats and maintaining a fast pace throughout the match.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate value and disrupt the opponent's plans. The inclusion of cards like Supreme Verdict and Portable Hole provide additional answers to threats on the board. The deck also includes lands that can provide utility and additional card draw. Overall, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and take control of the game's tempo to secure victory.

The main idea behind this Boros Aggro deck is to have a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Favored Hoplite to deal quick damage to the opponent. The deck also includes some protection spells like Gods Willing and Claim / Fame to keep key creatures alive. With the help of cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Illuminator Virtuoso, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to put Arclight Phoenix into play from the graveyard, all while disrupting opponents with cheap spells like Lightning Axe and Picklock Prankster. It also utilizes card draw with Treasure Cruise and Consider to maintain resources. The deck aims to apply pressure early game with aggressive plays and finish strong with powerful spells like Temporal Trespass and Prismari Command. The inclusion of Sleight of Hand and Spell Pierce provides additional versatility and interaction to ensure the deck's effectiveness in various matchups.

This deck focuses on using cheap spells and cantrips to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, which can then be brought back for free to pressure the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Spell Pierce to protect your threats and Treasure Cruise to refill your hand. The inclusion of Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder helps to further disrupt the opponent's game plan while also providing additional value. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and resilient against opposing strategies.

This red aggro deck aims to quickly burn down opponents with low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Ghitu Lavarunner while supplementing with direct damage spells like Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning. The deck also includes powerful enchantments like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear to generate additional damage. Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional value and control options, while cards like Monstrous Rage and Light Up the Stage ensure consistent card advantage and pressure on the opponent.

The deck revolves around assembling the combo of Lotus Field with cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This mana is used to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience, allowing for explosive plays. The deck also includes control elements like Archdruid's Charm and removal like Bala Ged Recovery to disrupt opponent's strategies. The goal is to set up the combo pieces efficiently while handling opponent's threats, ultimately overwhelming them with a flurry of powerful spells.

This deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control tool, utilizing a variety of multicolored cards to gain advantage and control the game. The deck includes cards like Leyline Binding and Molten Collapse for removal, Sylvan Caryatid for ramp, and Bring to Light for versatility. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad adds extra value by flickering permanents for additional advantage. With a mix of removal, card advantage, and ramp, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the board until it can secure a win using Niv-Mizzet or other powerful threats.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful life gain engine using cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Amalia Benavides Aguirre, which synergize with cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Aetherflux Reservoir to gain life and deal damage to opponents. The deck also utilizes Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for key combo pieces and creatures that can support the life gain strategy. By assembling the right pieces and managing life totals effectively, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a massive life total and finish them off with Aetherflux Reservoir.
